rows.caption:
Souris Community Cup is happy to announce 2026 fall development camps.

These camps are for players within common community cup parameters-
Essentially Souris players, either registered with Souris minor hockey or initially with Souris but now with KCK. 
Female players from Souris also playing in other associations qualify as well as any student at Ecole Belle Cloche.

Camp details are as follows 

All days are Tuesdays 
October 13th with Community Cup organizers.
October 20th with Campbell Hockey development
October 27th with Craig Jenkins

420 - u9 players
530 - u11 players
640 - u13 players

This development camp is hosted by Souris Community Cup and can be offered to players free of charge on the generosity of sponsors Souris Credit Union, Colville Bay Oyster co, South Lake Shellfish Co, Red Beard Shellfish co and East Cape Oyster co.

Donations will be received on site to use for further programs.

See you in the ice!

rows.caption:
While you're out picking up Thanksgiving dinner supplies today, please consider getting an extra item or two for next weekends Annual Food Drive on Saturday, October 17! Every item collected will help someone out, no donation is too small to be meaningful. 

From 9am - 2pm, volunteers will be collecting non-perishable food items and monetary donations at drive-thru locations throughout Stratford. 

If you would like to volunteer or for more information, please contact Elaine at (902) 569-4769 or email holyfamilypastoralunit@bellaliant.com.

#StratfordPEI

stage3.name: STRATFORD & AREA FOOD DRIVE DRIVE-THRU
stage3.description: In conjunction with the Big Fall Food Drive. Volunteers will collect non-perishable food items and monetary donations at drive-thru locations throughout Stratford. Locations: Our Lady of the Assumption Church, Stratford Town Hall, Sobeys Stratford, and Mike & Andreea's No Frills. Apartment building residents can leave donations in collection boxes at their main entryways during the week of October 12; boxes will be picked up the morning of October 17. Organized by Our Lady of the Assumption Parish. The poster lists tea and coffee, family-sized drinks, cereal, flaked canned meat, chunky or canned soup, canned beans, pasta and pasta sauce, crackers and cookies, juice boxes, canned vegetables, peanut butter, condiments, personal hygiene products, gluten-free products, and baby formula/diapers as needed items. Open Saturday & Sunday, 10 AM–4 PM 
Closed Monday for Thanksgiving Day.

From all of us at Island Hill Farm, we wish you a happy Thanksgiving filled with family, friends, and plenty of things to be thankful for!
